title: Rain-shadow contrast screen on r44 (declared before any knob is scored)
motivation: reports/NORTHERN_STEPPE_20261115.md section 7: r44 lee boxes 1.35-2.05x observed, windward boxes 0.65-0.73x (seen on r44 only; this is the diagnosis that motivates the screen).
box_rule: lon_min, lon_max, lat_min, lat_max; cells below 1800 m; medians of annual totals over cells
metric: contrast error = mean over pairs of |log(sim lee/sim windward) - log(obs lee/obs windward)|; also the three regions' rain loss and temperature MAE from benchmark_local
screen_rule: A knob passes the screen if contrast error falls by at least 25% AND the three regions' mean rain loss does not rise by more than 2%. Passing knobs (and at most one pairwise combination) go to the unchanged policy_v3 gate: dev49 S<=0.995, T/P<=+1%, fine28 S<=1.01, then one unseen sealed set.
no_map_changes: No atlas change from the screen.
